{{Quote|It is time for answers. I am sending you the location of a communications post the Deflarians use. Head over there and investigate.|[[Sinis]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CaB" />}}
The '''Deflarian Communications Post''' was a camp used by the criminal organization known as the [[Deflarians]] on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], near the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CaB" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a ship carrying medical equipment for the merchant [[Sinis]] apparently crashed near Tyrena. Sinis thus recruited a spacer to investigate the ship crash site and retrieve some equipment. The spacer spotted several Deflarian scavengers while they were placing a modified flight recorder in the wreckage. The spacer later assaulted the Deflarian Communications Post to find information about the involvement of the Deflarians in the crash. This allowed the spaced to find the location of another Deflarian camp and eventually retrieve Sinis's medical equipment.<ref name="SWG:CaB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Deflarian Communications Post appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CaB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Deflarian Communications Post was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
